concept.title: Snug tails
concept.hypotheses: The reciprocal sequence a: ℕ → ℝ, aₙ = 1/n.
concept.statement: A sequence a converges to L iff ∀ε > 0, ∃N ∈ ℕ, ∀n ≥ N, |aₙ − L| < ε. For aₙ = 1/n, limₙ→∞ aₙ = 0. For each ε > 0, N = ⌊1/ε⌋ + 1 is a valid threshold.
concept.visual_mapping: Creature heights are aₙ. The blanket is the positive part of the ε-neighbourhood of zero. Every creature from the threshold onward fits strictly inside.
concept.limitations: Only 50 terms are drawn and the selected term is enlarged. The scene demonstrates one convergent sequence; it does not model every convergent sequence or prove convergence.
concept.source_quote: This is a synthetic demonstration, not an extraction from Gyile’s coursework.
